# Spot-On Inspectorate

> Professional home defects inspection services for Singapore homeowners. Over 20 years of experience following BCA CONQUAS standards.

## Services

- [New Home Defects Inspection](https://soi.com.sg/#services): Pre-renovation inspection to identify defects in newly collected HDB, condo, or executive flats before renovation begins.
- [Post Renovation Defects Inspection](https://soi.com.sg/#services): Verify your interior designer delivers quality workmanship and identify defects for rectification.
- [Renovation Consultation](https://soi.com.sg/#services): Expert guidance during renovation to help homeowners make informed decisions.
- [HDB WiFi & Networking](https://soi.com.sg/#services): Professional networking and WiFi mesh consultation to overcome dead zones in HDB flats.

## Inspection Process

3-trip process:
1. Initial Inspection — meticulous identification of all potential defects using specialised equipment.
2. Joint Inspection — walkthrough with Building Service Centre (BSC) or Managing Agent (MA) to confirm all findings.
3. Final Rectification — verify all defects were properly fixed before move-in.

## FAQ Highlights

- Inspection scope covers tiles, painting, carpentry, workmanship, electrical, and plumbing.
- Duration: 1.5 to 3 hours depending on flat size and furnishing level.
- Owner presence not required for initial inspection; encouraged for joint inspection.
- Report turnaround: within 2 working days.
- Reports compiled and submitted to BSC/MA on the homeowner's behalf.
- Renovation Consultation includes a complimentary 3-month advisory platform (limited-time offer).
- Best time to book: after BTO key collection, condo handover, post-renovation, or before/after renting out.
